PROJECT ARES - playtest build for Linux

1. Unpack this folder anywhere you can write to and run ProjectAres.x86_64
   (double-click, or ./ProjectAres.x86_64 in a terminal). Keep
   ProjectAres.pck beside it: that is the game.
   It needs Vulkan graphics drivers (Mesa on Intel and AMD, the NVIDIA
   driver on NVIDIA). Without Vulkan it falls back to OpenGL, which draws a
   plainer picture.
   This build does not update itself yet: download the newest
   ProjectAres-linux-*.tar.gz from the "latest" release to update.
2. On a laptop the game picks lighter graphics on its first launch. Change
   it on the phone (P): Settings, View tab, Graphics quality.
3. Open your phone (P) and go to the Servers app. Pick your own player name
   there first: every player on a server needs a different name.
4. Under "A friend's server", type the host's address and press Join.
   Everyone must be on the same build as the host (the folder's name).

Report bugs with: what you did, what happened, what you expected, where, and
the build number (the start screen's corner).
